onb.welcome.title: Aaj kya banega, decided.
onb.welcome.body: Batao kitchen mein kya hai aur ghar mein kaun khaata hai. Cookmate batayega kya banana hai, aur voice se, aapki bhasha mein, step by step saath chalega.

onb.language.title: Apni bhasha chuniye
onb.members.title: Ghar mein kaun khaata hai?
onb.members.body: Jinke liye aap khana banate hain, unhe add karein. 6 log tak. Baad mein badal sakte hain.
onb.members.name: Naam
onb.spice.title: Kitna teekha pasand hai?
onb.spice.body: Bachchon ke liye halka rakhenge. Aapke feedback se Cookmate seekhta rahega.
onb.diet.title: Ghar mein kya khaate ho?

consent.voice_processing.title: Voice se cooking
consent.voice_processing.body: Aapki awaaz ko text mein badla jaata hai taaki Cookmate samajh sake. Recording rakhi nahi jaati.
consent.memory.title: Jo seekhe, yaad rakhe
consent.memory.body: Cookmate aapke feedback se taste yaad rakhega, jaise "agli baar lahsun zyada". Har memory aap dekh aur hata sakte ho.
consent.analytics.title: Cookmate ko better banao
consent.analytics.body: Sirf usage ki ginti. Aap kya bolte ya banate ho, woh kabhi nahi.
onb.consent.creating: Aapki kitchen ready ho rahi hai…
onb.error.create: Kitchen setup nahi ho payi. Aapki choices saved hain; dobara try karein.

kitchen.confirmBody: Jo galat hai theek karein, phir add karein.
kitchen.parseEmpty: Koi item nahi mila. Aise likho: "2 kilo aloo".
kitchen.addError: Add nahi ho paya. Aapki list yahin hai; dobara try karein.
item.notFound: Yeh item ab kitchen mein nahi hai.

home.focusNone: Abhi kisi dish mein {item} nahi hai; baaki mein se ye best hain

recipe.assumed: Aamtaur pe rasoi mein hota hai

adapt.noChange: Kam se kam ek badlaav chunein

quick.body: Dish chuno. Uski cheezein andaaze se jodunga, jab tak aap haan na kaho "Abhi bhi hai?" likha rahega.

quick.addedBody: Rasoi mein confirm karne tak ye suggestions mein nahi gine jayenge.

finish.failed: Yeh save nahi ho paaya. Dobara try karein, ya skip kar dein.

rescue.body: Ek chunein. Isi dish ke liye, aapki kitchen ki cheezon se upaay milega.

voice.soon.body: Tab tak aap type karke bata sakte hain ki ghar mein kya hai ya kya khane ka mann hai.
voice.consent.title: Voice ke liye aapki permission chahiye
voice.consent.body: Aapne Cookmate ko apni voice process karne ki permission nahi di hai. Aap type karke use karte reh sakte hain.
voice.ready.title: Hamari taraf se voice ready hai
voice.ready.body: Baat-cheet agle app update ke saath aayegi. Tab tak type karke batayein.

finish.rememberBody: Jo Cookmate ko yaad rakhna hai us par tap karein. Baad mein 'You' mein badal sakte hain.
list.title: Shopping list
list.emptyBody: Recipe ki missing cheezein aur kam padta ration yahan dikhega.
list.allBoughtBody: Kharidi hui cheezein seedhe aapki kitchen mein jud jaati hain.
list.copied: Copy ho gaya. WhatsApp mein paste karein.
home.remembered: Yaad rakh liya. 'You' mein badal sakte hain.

you.tell.more: Ab se recipes mein {item} thoda zyada
you.tell.less: Ab se recipes mein {item} thoda kam
you.tell.plain: Jaisa aapne kaha, waisa hi rakha
you.prefsBody: Jo kha rahe hain, unmein kisi ko jo pasand nahi, woh suggestions mein nahi aayega.
you.prefsEmpty: Abhi kuch nahi. Kisi ki pasand ya napasand jodiye.
you.prefUnknown: "{item}" abhi pata nahi. Koi doosra naam try karein.
you.savedEmpty: Kisi dish par dil tap karein, woh yahan rahegi.
you.voice.title: Main aapse kaise baat karun
you.voice.body: Voice se khana banate waqt aur steps padhkar sunate waqt.
you.phone.title: Apni rasoi safe rakhein
you.phone.body: Apna phone number jodiye, taaki naye phone par sab wapas mil jaaye. Yahan kuch nahi badlega.
you.phone.sent: {phone} par 6 digit ka code bheja hai.
you.phone.wrongCode: Yeh code nahi chala. Check karein, ya naya code mangaiye.
you.phone.taken: Yeh number kisi aur account mein hai.
you.phone.notReady: Phone se sign-in abhi chalu nahi hai. Aapki rasoi is phone par save hai.
you.privacy.title: Privacy
you.privacy.exportBody: Cookmate aapke ghar ke baare mein jo kuch rakhta hai, sab ek file mein.
you.privacy.deleteHint: Aapka account aur woh rasoi hatata hai jo sirf aapki hain.
you.privacy.deleteBody: Isse aapka account abhi hat jaayega. Jo rasoi sirf aapki hai, woh sab kuch samet hat jaayegi: saamaan, yaadein, khana banane ki history. Jis rasoi ko koi aur bhi chalata hai, usmein se sirf aap hatenge. Ise wapas nahi kiya ja sakta.
cook.offline: Network nahi hai. Pakate rahiye: sab is phone par save hai aur network aate hi sync ho jayega.
cook.hf.start: Hands-free: agla, pichla, phir se aur timer suniye
cook.hf.listening: Sun rahe hain. Boliye "agla", "pichla", "phir se" ya "10 minute ka timer". Bina network ke bhi chalta hai.
cook.hf.denied: Cookmate ke liye microphone band hai. Hands-free pakane ke liye phone ki settings mein ise on karein.
cook.hf.unavailable: Is phone par hands-free sunna available nahi hai. Agla aur Pichla dabaiye.
cook.hf.hint: Agla, pichla, phir se ya timer boliye.
cook.hf.lastStep: Yeh aakhri step hai. Khana ban jaye to "ban gaya" boliye.
finish.offline: Aap offline hain, isliye network aate hi recipe ki quantity aapki kitchen se ghata denge. Uske baad Kitchen mein koi bhi cheez theek kar sakte hain.
home.check.title: Kya {item} abhi bhi hai?
home.fast.title: Kya aaj {name} ka vrat hai?
home.fast.yes: Haan, vrat ke hisaab se suggest kijiye
home.fast.kept: Aaj ke suggestions {name} ke vrat ke hisaab se hain
home.invent: Jo hai usse kuch naya banaiye
invent.title: Kuch naya
invent.loading: Bachi hui cheezon se kuch soch rahe hain…
invent.note: Yeh nayi creation hai, tested recipe nahi. Yeh hamari food-safety jaanch mein pass hui hai; banate hue chakhte rahiye.
invent.tooLittle.title: Zyada kuch nahi hai
invent.tooLittle.body: Yeh bache hue khane, ghar ki chutney ya jaldi kharab hone wali cheezon se sabse accha chalta hai. Unhe Kitchen mein jodiye.
invent.unsafe.title: Kuch safe nahi ban paya
invent.unsafe.body: Jo socha woh hamari safety jaanch mein pass nahi hua, isliye hum use nahi batayenge. Thodi der mein phir try kijiye.
invent.unavailable.title: Abhi chalu nahi hai
invent.unavailable.body: Naye dishes sochna abhi available nahi hai. Aapke suggestions pehle ki tarah kaam karte hain.
you.notify.title: Dinner ka time
you.notify.body: Bataiye aap kab khaate hain. Usse pehle Cookmate batayega ki bache time mein kya ban sakta hai, taaki khana time par ho.
you.notify.denied: Phone ki settings mein Cookmate ke notifications band hain.
you.notify.noDevice: Yeh phone abhi ise nahi paa sakta. Cookmate store se install hone par shuru hoga.
you.notify.badTime: Yeh time quiet time ke andar hai.
home.fast.none.title: Abhi vrat wale dishes nahi hain
home.fast.none.body: Cookmate mein abhi is vrat ke dishes nahi hain; aur jode ja rahe hain.
onb.w.overline: Roz ke ghar ke khaane ke liye
onb.w.title: Miliye apni rasoi ke saathi se.
onb.w.body: Cookmate jaanta hai ghar mein kya hai, samajhta hai aapka kya khaane ka mann hai, aur khaana banaate waqt har step pe saath deta hai.
onb.w.f1.title: Aapki rasoi jaanta hai
onb.w.f1.body: Fridge, almari aur freezer mein kya hai, yaad rakhta hai. Koi list nahi banaani.
onb.w.f2.title: Aapka swaad jaanta hai
onb.w.f2.body: Seekhta hai parivaar ko kya pasand hai, ghar ke khaane ke niyam aur aap kitna teekha banaate hain.
onb.w.f3.title: Aapke saath pakaata hai
onb.w.f3.body: Har step bolkar batata hai, haath lagaye bina, aur batata hai kya dekhein, sunein aur soonghein.
onb.w.note: Email ya password ki zaroorat nahi.
onb.k.title: Chaliye dekhein aapki rasoi mein kya hai.
onb.k.body: Jo aamtaur pe ghar mein rehta hai, us pe tap karein. Main yaad rakhunga aur bataunga kya ban sakta hai.
onb.k.scan.title: Camera se scan karein
onb.k.scan.body: Phone ko fridge ya almari ki taraf karein, main pehchaan lunga kya rakha hai.
onb.k.scan.soon: Setup ke baad Kitchen tab se scan karein
onb.k.empty: Abhi kuch nahi. Neeche se cheezein tap karke jodein.
onb.k.own: Ya khud likhein (jaise bachi hui dal)
onb.k.tip: In {n} cheezon se main abhi {count} dish suggest kar sakta hoon, jaise {dishes}.
onb.k.tipOne: In {n} cheezon se main abhi {dishes} suggest kar sakta hoon.
onb.k.tipNone: Kuch aur cheezein jodein, phir main bataunga kya ban sakta hai.
onb.f.title: Yahan kaun-kaun khaata hai?
onb.f.body: Jinke liye aap khaana banaate hain, sabko jodein. Main dhyaan rakhunga ki har thaali unke hisaab se ho.
onb.f.dietNote: Baad mein har vyakti ke liye alag rakh sakte hain.
onb.f.diet.jain: Pyaaz, lahsun ya zameen ke neeche ki sabziyan nahi
onb.f.diet.vegan: Doodh, ghee ya dahi bhi nahi
onb.t.title: Ab bataiye aapko kya pasand hai.
onb.t.body: Main teekhapan, swaad aur pakaane ka samay aapke parivaar ke hisaab se rakhunga.
onb.t.spiceNote: Badon ke liye. Bachchon ke liye kam rakhunga.
onb.t.spiceSay.1: Bilkul mirch nahi. Halka aur aaraamdaayak.
onb.t.spiceSay.2: Adrak aur kaali mirch ki halki garmaahat, mirch lagbhag nahi.
onb.t.spiceSay.3: Roz ka ghar jaisa teekha: tadke mein ek hari mirch.
onb.t.spiceSay.4: Aapko laal aur hari mirch ka achha teekha pasand hai.
onb.t.cuisinesBody: Jo khaana sabse zyada pasand hai, woh chunein.
onb.t.paceBody: Aamtaur pe kitna samay hota hai?
onb.t.pace.quickBody: Ek bartan wali dish, aasaan steps, kam bartan dhone.
onb.t.pace.relaxed: Mujhe aaraam se pakaana pasand hai
onb.t.pace.relaxedBody: Dheemi aanch ki dal, curry aur chhutti wale khaas pakwaan bhi.
onb.t.avoidBody: Main inhe kisi bhi dish mein nahi daalunga.
onb.t.unknown: Yeh mujhe abhi nahi pata. Koi aur naam try karein.

kitchen.addTip: Koi bhi bhasha chalegi: Hindi, English ya mix. Jodne se pehle main padhkar sunaunga.
scan.body.fridge: Fridge ya almari kholkar ek photo lein. Main usme khaane ki cheezein dhoondh lunga.
scan.body.bill: Bill ko seedha rakhein, achhi roshni mein. Jo khareeda, main jod dunga.
scan.body.barcode: Packet ka barcode frame mein rakhein. Jitne chahein, scan karein.
scan.privacy: Photo sirf khaane ki cheezein dhoondhne ke liye ek baar dekhi jaati hai, phir mita di jaati hai. Kabhi save nahi hoti.
scan.allowBody: Fridge, bill ya barcode dekhne ke liye Cookmate ko camera chahiye.
scan.noCamera: Yahan camera nahi hai. Scan phone ke app mein chalta hai.
scan.nothing: Usme khaane ki koi cheez nahi mili. Paas se, achhi roshni mein phir se lein, ya likhkar jodein.
scan.notOn: Photo scan abhi chalu nahi hai. Abhi likhkar jodein.
scan.unknownBarcode: Yeh packet mujhe abhi nahi pata. Iska naam likhkar jodein.
scan.error: Yeh nahi hua. Internet dekhkar phir se koshish karein.

timers.noneBody: Neeche kisi step ka ya jaldi wala timer shuru karein.
community.emptyFeedBody: Khaana banaane ke baad "Circle ke saath share karein" dabaayein. Doosron ki dish yahan dikhengi.
community.welcome.title: Parivaar aur doston ke saath khaana banayein
community.welcome.body: Ek chhota circle banaiye: Mummy, behen, woh dost jo sabse achha rajma banaati hai. Dekhiye sabne kya banaya, kya badla, aur khud banaiye.
community.privacy: Private: jo aap share karein, sirf wahi, aur sirf unhein dikhega jinhein aap bulaayein.
community.problem.invite_not_found: Yeh code nahi chala. Jaanch lein, ya naya maang lein: code 7 din chalta hai.
community.problem.circle_full: Yeh circle bhar gaya hai (30 rasoi).
community.problem.too_many_circles: Aap pehle se 10 circle mein hain. Ek chhodkar doosra jodein.
community.problem.too_many_posts: Aaj 20 baar share ho gaya. Kal phir karein.
community.inviteMessage: Cookmate par mere cooking circle "{circle}" se judein. Community kholein, "Code se judein" dabaayein aur {code} daalein.
community.noCircle: Aap abhi kisi circle mein nahi hain
community.noCircleBody: Community mein circle banayein ya code se judein, phir share karein.
community.sharedBody: Woh ise Community mein dekhenge aur bana bhi sakenge.
community.notePlaceholder: Jaise: rajma raat bhar bhigoyein, farak padta hai
community.yourChangesBody: Rakhne ya hataane ke liye dabaayein. Doosre inhein dish ke saath dekhenge.
community.shareWhat: Sirf dish, aapke badlaav aur aapki baat share hogi, is circle ke liye chune naam se. Aapki rasoi ka saamaan, parivaar ke naam ya Cookmate ki yaad rakhi baatein kabhi nahi.
community.shareFromFinishBody: Parivaar aur dost dekhein aapne kya banaya, aur khud bhi banayein.
plate.title: Is hafte ki thali
plate.note: Aapki thali mein kya aaya, khane ke hisaab se. Koi calorie nahi, koi ginti nahi.
plate.empty: Cookmate ke saath kuch baar khana banaiye, phir yahan aapki hafte ki thali dikhegi.
plate.thin: Kuch aur baar khana bane, to agle hafte ke liye sujhav yahan dikhenge.
plate.balanced: Achha santulit hafta raha. Aise hi chalte rahiye.
plate.tip.greens: Do-ek baar palak, methi ya koi aur hari pattedar sabzi banaiye.
plate.tip.dal: Kuch aur din dal, rajma ya chana rakhiye.
plate.tip.sabzi: Zyada baar thali mein ek sabzi rakhiye.
plate.tip.dairy: Dopahar ya raat ke khane ke saath ek katori dahi achha rehta hai.
plate.tip.fruit: Khane ke baad ya beech mein khane ke liye kuch phal rakhiye.
balance.title: Poora khana banaiye
balance.addProtein: Saath mein ek katori dal ya dahi rakh dein, to khana poora ho jata hai.
balance.addProteinVegan: Saath mein ek katori dal, chana ya mutthi bhar moongphali rakh dein, to khana poora ho jata hai.
balance.addVeg: Saath mein ek sabzi ya kachumber salad rakh dijiye.
left.title: Isse kuch naya banaiye
left.body: Kharab hone se pehle ise istemaal karne ke aasaan tareeke.
left.reheat: Ise ek hi baar garam karein, aur tab tak ki andar tak bhaap nikalne lage.
left.riceCare: Pake chawal: fridge mein rakhein aur ek din ke andar kha lein. Bahar counter par na chhodein.
left.idea.dalParatha.b: Dal ko aate mein thode namak aur ajwain ke saath goondh lein, phir aam parathe ki tarah belkar sekein.
left.idea.dalChilla.b: Gaadhi dal mein besan, kata pyaaz aur mirch milakar ghol banayein aur tawe par patle cheele banayein.
left.idea.dalTadka.b: Thoda garam paani daalkar ubaalein, aur upar se ghee, jeere aur lehsun ka naya tadka lagayein.
left.idea.rajmaWrap.b: Thoda masal lein, roti par pyaaz aur hari chutney ke saath phailayein aur roll kar lein.
left.idea.rajmaTikki.b: Paani nikaalkar uble aloo aur thode pohe ya bread ke saath maslein, tikki banakar halka talein.
left.idea.lemonRice.b: Rai, curry patte, moongphali aur haldi ka tadka lagayein, chawal milayein aur upar se nimbu nichodein.
left.idea.curdRice.b: Chawal garam karke thanda karein, dahi aur namak milayein, upar se rai aur curry patte ka tadka lagayein.
left.idea.friedRice.b: Tez aanch par pyaaz, shimla mirch aur jo sabzi ho bhoonein, phir chawal, namak aur kaali mirch daalein.
left.idea.khichdiTikki.b: Besan, pyaaz aur dhaniya milakar chhoti tikki banayein aur tawe par kurkura hone tak sekein.
left.idea.khichdiParatha.b: Khichdi ko aate mein goondhein, belkar sekein. Dahi aur achaar ke saath achha lagta hai.
left.idea.rotiNoodles.b: Rotiyon ko patli pattiyon mein kaatein aur pyaaz, shimla mirch, thodi sauce aur mirch ke saath bhoonein.
left.idea.rotiChuri.b: Garam rotiyon ko ghee aur gud ke saath masal lein. Khane ke baad ka jhatpat meetha.
left.idea.stuffedParatha.b: Sabzi ko masalkar bele hue aate mein bharein, band karke phir belein, aur thode ghee mein sekein.
left.idea.toastie.b: Bread ke do slice ke beech phailayein, thoda makkhan lagakar tawe par sekein.
left.idea.curryWrap.b: Gaadha hone tak pakayein, roti ya parathe mein pyaaz ke chhallon aur nimbu ke saath lapetein.
left.idea.curryPulao.b: Taaze garam chawal ke saath partein lagayein, dhakkar paanch minute dheemi aanch par rakhein.
left.idea.kadhiChawal.b: Thoda paani daalkar garam karein, chalaate rahein taaki phate nahi, aur taaze chawal ke saath parosein.
left.idea.kadhiPakora.b: Kuch taaze pyaaz ke pakode talein aur khane se theek pehle daalein.
left.idea.pohaCutlet.b: Uble aloo ke saath maslein, cutlet banayein aur sunehra hone tak halka talein.
left.idea.anyWrap.b: Garam karein, pyaaz aur chutney ke saath roti mein lapetein, aur khana taiyaar.
restock.title: {item} khatam hone ko hai?
restock.days: Aap ise aamtaur par har {n} din mein laate hain.
restock.week: Aap ise aamtaur par har hafte laate hain.
restock.weeks: Aap ise aamtaur par har do hafte mein laate hain.
restock.month: Aap ise aamtaur par har mahine laate hain.
restock.never: Cookmate khud kuch order nahi karta, yeh sirf yaad dilana hai.
ready.body: Aapki rasoi mein pehle se bana hai: {items}. Paanch minute mein khana taiyaar, kuch naya banane ki zaroorat nahi.
ready.heatRice: Ek hi baar, bhaap nikalne tak garam karein. Chawal ek din ke andar kha lein.
amt.cardBody: {n} cheezon ki matra abhi nahi hai. Jod dein, taaki Cookmate ko pata rahe ki kab khatam hone wali hain.
amt.title: Aapke paas kitna hai?
amt.body: Sabse kareeb wali matra chunein. Andaaza bhi chalega.
amt.allSet: Har cheez ki matra jud gayi.
drinks.toggleBody: Chai, lassi, sharbat aur mocktail wala Drinks tab dikhata hai. Cocktail sirf aapke chunne par.
drinks.title: Kuch peene ko
drinks.sub: Aapki rasoi mein jo hai, usse.
drinks.age.title: Cocktail mein sharaab hoti hai
drinks.age.body: Kripya pushti karein ki aap apne rajya mein sharaab peene ki kanooni umar ke hain. Yeh is phone par ek hi baar poochha jayega.
drinks.responsibly: Zimmedari se piyein. Peekar gaadi kabhi na chalayein.
ask.title: Cookmate se poochhein
ask.introTitle: Apni rasoi ke baare mein kuch bhi poochhein
ask.introBody: Cookmate jaanta hai ki rasoi mein kya hai, kaun kha raha hai aur aapko kya pasand hai.
ask.s.make: 20 minute mein kya bana sakte hain?
ask.s.soon: Kya jaldi kharab hone wala hai?
ask.s.guests: Raat ko mehmaan aa rahe hain. Kya banayein?
ask.placeholder: Apni rasoi ke baare mein poochhein…
ask.error: Abhi jawab nahi mila. Connection dekhkar phir koshish karein.
invent.named.title: {dish}
invent.named.loading: Aapki rasoi ke liye {dish} ki recipe likhi ja rahi hai…
invent.named.note: Yeh recipe Cookmate ne aapki rasoi ke liye likhi hai; yeh jaanchi-parkhi nahi hai. Yeh hamari food safety jaanch mein pass hai, chakhte hue banaiye.
invent.named.fail.title: Abhi {dish} ki recipe nahi likhi ja saki
invent.named.fail.body: Ismein bahut zyada khareedari lagti, ya yeh food safety jaanch mein pass nahi hui. Koi aur dish aazmayein, ya thodi der mein phir koshish karein.
kitchen.ranOutBody: Cookmate ise khatam maankar aapki list mein jod dega.
kitchen.confirmOut: Khatam karein aur list mein jodein
finish.noticedBody: Khana banate samay aapne jo badla, usse. Jo sirf aaj ke liye tha, uska nishaan hata dein.
home.hero.title.lunch: Aaj dopahar ke khane mein kya banega?
home.hero.title.dinner: Aaj raat ke khane mein kya banega?
home.hero.title.snack: Aaj shaam ke naashte mein kya banega?
plan.offer.title: Kal {dish}?
plan.offer.easy: Aaj raat kuch nahi karna. Abhi tay kar lein, kal ki fikr khatam.
plan.nothingAhead: Aaj raat kuch taiyaar nahi karna.
plan.doneTonight: Aaj raat ka kaam ho gaya
plan.prepDone: Taiyaari kal raat ho gayi. Jab chahein banayein.
plan.prepNotDone: Pehle lagbhag {hours} ghante ki taiyaari chahiye.
plan.need.marinate: {item} pehle se fridge mein marinate karein (lagbhag {hours} ghante)
plan.need.rest: Step {step} pehle se shuru karein (lagbhag {hours} ghante)
plan.need.set_curd: Aaj raat doodh se dahi jama dein (lagbhag {hours} ghante)
plan.need.defrost: {item} freezer se fridge mein rakh dein (lagbhag {hours} ghante)
finish.react.title: Sabko kaisa laga?
onb.welcome.error.closed: Abhi naye sign-up ruke hue hain. Thodi der baad phir koshish karein.
onb.welcome.error.busy: Abhi bahut baar koshish hui. Ek minute rukkar phir koshish karein.
onb.welcome.error.other: Shuru karte samay kuch gadbad hui. Phir koshish karein.
scan.body.photo: Fridge, almaari ya bill: jitni chahein photo lein. Ya online order ke screenshot chunein.
scan.trayFrom: {n} photo se. Ek aur lein, ya ho jaaye to jaanch lein.
scan.trayFromOne: 1 photo se. Ek aur lein, ya ho jaaye to jaanch lein.
scan.shotFailed: Ek photo padhi nahi gayi. Thoda paas se phir lein.
scan.shotEmpty: Us photo mein khaane ki cheez nahi mili. Paas se, achhi roshni mein lein.
kitchen.scanFirst.title: Ek minute mein rasoi bharein
kitchen.scanFirst.body: Fridge aur almaari ki, ya bill ya online order ki kuch photo lein. Cookmate cheezein dhoondh lega, aap bas jaanch lein.
kitchen.scanFirst.more: Baaki cheezein kuch photo se jodein
kitchen.scanFirst.moreBody: Fridge, almaari, bill ya order ka screenshot.
tools.title: Aap kisse khana banate hain?
tools.body: Taaki main wahi sujhaoon jo aap bana sakein, aur har step par aapke chulhe ki sahi setting bataoon.
tools.powerQ: Aapka induction power kaise dikhata hai?
tools.youBody: Sujhav mein woh dish nahi aayengi jo aap nahi bana sakte, aur har step aapke chulhe ki setting batayega.
air.title: Air fryer
air.general: Aam tareeka: ek minute pehle dekh lein
air.safety: Basket aur nikalti bhaap bahut garam hoti hai: handle se nikaalein aur bachchon ko door rakhein.
tools.seen: Mujhe yeh bhi dikha: {names}. Rasoi ke tools mein jodein?
tools.seenAdded: Rasoi ke tools mein jud gaya.
tools.togetherQ: Kya yeh ek saath chal sakte hain?
tools.togetherHint: Agar ek hi socket hai ya switch trip ho jaata hai, to 'ek baar mein ek' chunein. Main steps usi hisaab se bataunga.
limits.busy: Aapka {device} abhi step {n} mein laga hai ({time} baaki).
limits.busyGas: Gas ke saare burner chal rahe hain (step {n} wala {time} mein khaali hoga).
limits.clash: Aapka {other} abhi chal raha hai ({time} baaki), aur {device} iske saath nahi chal sakta.
limits.wait: {other} ke khatam hone tak rukein; uska timer bajega. Tab tak sab taiyaar rakhein.
limits.airFirst: Aapka induction aur air fryer ek saath nahi chalte: shuru karne se pehle induction band karein.
home.dinner.title: Dinner {time} baje · {left} baaki
home.dinner.body: Bache time mein kya ban sakta hai:
home.dinner.none: Abhi kitchen mein jaldi banne wala kuch nahi dikha.
swaps.title: Kuch alag banaiye
swaps.twistHow.shahi: Meve ka smooth paste banakar end mein doodh ya malai ke saath gravy mein milaiye. Rich, mild, thoda meetha.
swaps.twistHow.kofta: Main sabzi ko thode besan aur namak ke saath mash karein, chhote gole banakar halka fry ya air fry karein, aur serve karne se pehle gravy mein daalein.
swaps.twistHow.tikka: Tukdon ko gaadhe dahi, besan aur masalon mein lapetein, 20 minute rakhein, phir garam tawe ya air fryer mein kinare bhunne tak sekein.
swaps.twistHow.dum: Phenta hua dahi daalein, tight dhakkan lagayein aur sabse dheemi aanch par 10 minute pakayein taaki masala andar tak jaaye.
cook.basicsBody: Roti, paratha, puri, bhatura aur kulche ka aata, saath mein chaawal aur dal. Kitne log kha rahe hain chunein: 1 katori aate se lagbhag 4 roti banti hain.

cook.heat.higher: Samajh gaya: aapka {stove} dheema hai, ab se ek level zyada bataunga.

cook.heat.notedSlow: Abhi ek level badha dein. Phir aisa hua to aapke {stove} ki setting hamesha ke liye badha dunga.
